attachments.reason.no-token: the-loop holds no token for it
attachments.reason.off-host: its URL is not on the file host
attachments.reason.too-many: past the cap of {max_files} files per message
bodies.mirror.context.added: 📎 context from {who} on the **{source}** channel — {count} message(s) from {thread}, recorded here and appended to `context.md` by the session
bodies.mirror.decision.recorded: 📌 decision from {who} on the **{source}** channel{kind} — recorded here and written up as a decision record by the session
bodies.mirror.work-item.reply: reply from {who} on the **{source}** channel, recorded here as the answer of record
dispatcher.refusal.channel-taken: That Slack channel already backs another work item. One room backs one work item, so declare a different channel or free the current one first.
dispatcher.refusal.hook-refused: A lifecycle hook declined this. The work item is disarmed; fix what the hook names and start it again.
dispatcher.refusal.input-refused: A lifecycle hook declined this input — it was not delivered to the session and nothing was run. The reason follows.
dispatcher.refusal.missing-channel: I couldn't find that Slack channel. Check the spelling, invite me to the channel (once I'm a member its name resolves), or use its conversation id — that always works.
dispatcher.refusal.missing-collaborator: I couldn't resolve that collaborator. Use a GitHub login (or a Slack id the roster already knows), and check the spelling.
dispatcher.refusal.nothing-to-resume: There's nothing paused to resume here — the work item is not in a paused state.
dispatcher.refusal.unknown-listen-mode: I don't know that `--listen` mode. Use `all` or `mentions`.
slack.command-description.do: a tactical task — no spec chain or phase gates; the-loop works it until you say it is done.
slack.command-description.start: the full PDLC — phase selection, requirements, design, testing plan, reviews and an approval gate.
slack.kickoff-refusal.no-pending-kickoff: this question is no longer open — it was already answered, or it expired. Post the message again to file it
slack.kickoff-refusal.not-your-kickoff: this question belongs to the member who posted the message, so only they can answer it
slack.kickoff-refusal.undeclared-reposit: that is not one of the repositories this question offered, so nothing was created
slack.kickoff-refusal.unpublishable-even: this channel is no longer set up to open work items, so nothing was created — ask whoever configured the-loop
